Committee and manager reports followed, with brief public comment.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted to re-recommend the capital plan, article 5, with revised funding sources that draw more on free cash.
The committee re-recommended the omnibus budget, article 6, with the town manager's revisions to the recycling line, after the recycling bid came in well above the estimate.
The committee voted to recommend the DPW contract, article 17, with first-year cost to come from the salary reserve.
The committee voted to change the prior-year invoice article after an additional FY20 amount was found owing.
The committee took no action on the TC Pacios new-building study article, preferring to wait for the town meeting floor discussion.

why_it_matters: A higher recycling bid shifts how the capital plan is paid for and raises the operating cost carried in the omnibus budget, which residents will be asked to vote on at town meeting.

The TC Pacios renovation versus new-build question was left open by the committee, so residents will hear it first on the town meeting floor, where a vote on spending to study a new building will be taken.
watch_next: The committee's next meeting on the 13th, set to revisit procedures, town meeting wrap-up and the capital planning policy change.
A redlined document on capital project trigger numbers that a member is to bring before the committee votes.
